review.why: Searchable local UI/UX knowledge base: styles, palettes, font pairings, UX rules, charts and 22 stacks, plus a design-system generator you can persist.
review.summary: A priority-ordered rule set (accessibility first) backed by a Python search tool over CSV data: 80 styles, about 190 product palettes, 74 font pairings, 130 UX guidelines, 105 icons, GSAP presets, 25 chart types and 22 stack guides. Can generate a design system, write MASTER.md with page overrides, export design tokens and tune variance, motion and density dials.
strengths: Large local dataset with provenance and a test suite; no network access in the scripts, and files are only written with --persist or --preview.
Disciplined query contract: one intent per query, verify the match, retry once, and say so when nothing matches.
Design-system output (pattern, style, colors, fonts, anti-patterns) that persists across sessions with a master and page overrides.
cautions: Commands use a CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT path, so they work as a plugin; installed as a plain skill the script path must be adjusted.
Product palettes and style recommendations are general defaults, and the pro-rules checklist targets native and mobile apps.
SKILL.md read in full; scripts checked for network and file writes; the CSV data was sampled, not read in full. Not run here.
